text: I have a dataset of 50 adversarial trafficking-prompt + chat-response pairs, and I want to grade the responses on the 21-dim rubric. Compare the expected grading-quality of: (a) using the same Gemma 4 E2B for chat AND grading; (b) using Gemma 4 E2B for chat, abliterated Gemma 4 31B for grading; (c) using Gemma 4 E2B for chat, GPT-4 as judge. For each option, what's the cost / latency / privacy / accuracy profile?

I ran the same 50-test adversarial suite through 3 grader configurations: (1) in-process Gemma E2B, (2) abliterated Gemma 31B, (3) GPT-4. The pass-rates differ: 64% / 78% / 71%. Walk through the diagnostics: (a) which grader-pairs are likely to disagree on which dim categories, (b) what does the 64% vs 78% gap tell me about the in-process self-grade pattern, (c) which configuration's score should I trust as ground-truth, (d) the methodological caveats.
